text: Stonefield Distribution's four day-to-day subledgers -- Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, and Fixed Assets -- all get planned before Theo builds a single one of them.
Accounts Payable has two real invoice paths: PO-matched invoices, and standalone invoices like freight and utility bills that Arjun Mehta's team keys in directly, with no purchase order at all.

Accounts Receivable is planned around Felicity Dunmore's billing and collections work; Cash Management around real bank accounts and statement reconciliation; Fixed Assets around real asset categories and depreciation.
None of the four subledgers get built in this video -- this is the plan Simone Alvarez signs off on before implementation starts.
Next: planning Subledger Accounting -- the rules engine that turns every one of these transactions into an actual journal entry.
